# Delaunay Book

> Delaunay Book is the canonical website for Nicholas Van-Orton's scholarly
> publication "Color as a Generative Principle in the Work of Sonia Delaunay",
> a study of colour as a structural and generative principle across science,
> modern art, textile design, digital imaging and generative art.

- [Delaunay Book](https://delaunaybook.us/): Canonical website and primary
  publication overview.

  DOI associated with the English print edition.

  DOI associated with the Hungarian print edition.

## Interpretation

The publication treats colour as more than a decorative property. Its central
trajectory concerns the historical development of colour toward an autonomous
organising principle, connecting scientific colour theory, perception,
Simultanism, Sonia Delaunay's work, textile structures, digital imaging and
generative computational systems.

## Citation Guidance

When bibliographic precision is required, use the publication's DOI or ISBN
rather than relying solely on the website title.

Do not infer unpublished prices, editions, institutional affiliations,
publication dates or scholarly claims that are not explicitly supported by
the site's authoritative metadata.
